privacy.metaDescription: Learn how Pilloto collects, uses, and protects personal data. Covers the pilloto.com website, the Pilloto PMS platform, and hotel guest data processing.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Pilloto SRL ("Pilloto", "we", "us") collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data when you visit our website at pilloto.com or use the Pilloto property management platform. Pilloto is incorporated in the Dominican Republic and operates under Dominican Republic Law 172-13 on the Protection of Personal Data. Where applicable, we also comply with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and relevant U.S. state privacy laws.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.body: The data controller for personal data collected through the pilloto.com website and marketing activities is: Pilloto SRL, Matachalupe, Higüey, Dominican Republic 23000. Email: info@pilloto.com. When Pilloto processes hotel guest data on behalf of a hotel customer using our platform, the hotel is the data controller and Pilloto acts as a data processor. See Section 16 for details.

dataCollected.title: 2. Categories of Personal Data We Collect
dataCollected.intro: We may collect the following categories of personal data depending on your interaction with us:
items: Contact information: name, email address, phone number (provided via our contact form or sales inquiries)
Account data: email, name, role, login credentials (for platform users)
Usage data: pages visited, browser type, IP address, device information, language preference
Transaction data: subscription plan, billing history (for paying customers)
Communication data: messages sent through our contact form or support channels
Cookie and tracking data: see our Cookie Policy for full details

sources.title: 3. Sources of Data
sources.body: We collect data directly from you when you fill out our contact form, create an account, or interact with our platform. We also collect data automatically through cookies and server logs when you visit our website.

purposes.title: 4. Purposes of Processing
purposes.intro: We process personal data for the following purposes:
items: To respond to your inquiries submitted through our contact form
To provide and maintain the Pilloto platform and services
To manage your account and subscription
To send transactional emails related to your account or reservations (system-generated only — we do not send marketing email)
To improve our website and services through aggregated analytics
To ensure the security of our platform and prevent abuse
To comply with legal obligations under Dominican Republic law

legalBases.title: 5. Legal Bases for Processing
legalBases.body: Under Dominican Republic Law 172-13, we process personal data on the basis of your consent where required, for the performance of a contract (our Terms of Service), and to comply with legal obligations. For visitors subject to the GDPR, our legal bases include: consent (for optional cookies), contractual necessity (to provide our services), legitimate interests (security, analytics), and legal compliance.

sharing.title: 6. Data Sharing and Recipients
sharing.intro: We may share personal data with:
items: Cloud infrastructure providers (Amazon Web Services) for hosting and service delivery
Email delivery services (Amazon SES) for transactional email on behalf of our platform customers
Payment processors for subscription billing
Professional advisors (legal, accounting) where required
sharing.noSale: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties for their marketing purposes.

internationalTransfers.title: 7. International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.body: Pilloto is based in the Dominican Republic. Our infrastructure is hosted on Amazon Web Services in the United States. If you are accessing our website or services from outside the Dominican Republic or the United States, your data may be transferred to and processed in these jurisdictions. We implement appropriate safeguards including contractual protections to ensure your data is protected in accordance with applicable law.

retention.title: 8. Data Retention
retention.body: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law. Contact form submissions are retained for up to 24 months. Account data is retained for the duration of your subscription and for up to 12 months after cancellation. Server logs and usage data are retained for up to 90 days. You can request deletion at any time by contacting info@pilloto.com.

security.title: 9. Security
security.body: We implement technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, including encryption in transit (TLS), access controls, authentication safeguards, and regular security reviews. For more information, see our Security page.

rights.title: 10. Your Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data. We honour data subject rights regardless of location, though specific legal frameworks may apply based on where you reside.

drRights.title: 11. Rights Under Dominican Republic Law 172-13
drRights.body: Under Dominican Law 172-13, you have the right to:
items: Access your personal data held by us
Request rectification of inaccurate data
Request deletion of your data
Object to processing of your data
File a complaint with the Dominican Republic National Council for the Regulation and Promotion of Telecommunications (INDOTEL)

gdprRights.title: 12. Rights Under the GDPR (EU/UK Visitors)
gdprRights.body: If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, you additionally have the right to:
items: Receive your data in a portable format
Restrict processing in certain circumstances
Withdraw consent at any time (where processing is based on consent)
Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority

usRights.title: 13. U.S. State Privacy Rights
usRights.body: If you reside in California or another U.S. state with comprehensive privacy legislation, you may have additional rights including the right to know what data we collect, the right to delete, and the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information. We do not sell personal information. To exercise your rights, contact us at info@pilloto.com.

children.title: 14. Children's Privacy
children.body: Our website and services are not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe we have inadvertently collected data from a child, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

cookieReference.title: 15. Cookies

By accessing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

scope.body: These Terms apply to all visitors of the pilloto.com website and to all customers who subscribe to and use the Pilloto property management platform. Additional terms may apply to specific features or services, and will be presented to you at the time of subscription or activation. These Terms incorporate by reference our Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, and Acceptable Use Policy.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility

accountResponsibilities.title: 3. Account Responsibilities

serviceDescription.title: 4. Service Description
serviceDescription.body: Pilloto is a cloud-based property management system (PMS) that helps hotels manage reservations, guest profiles, room inventory, billing, events, day passes, and related operations. Features available to you depend on your subscription plan. We may update, modify, or discontinue features at our discretion, with reasonable notice to active subscribers.

billing.title: 5. Billing and Payments

cookiePolicy.metaDescription: Learn about the cookies and similar technologies used on pilloto.com, their purposes, and how to manage your preferences.
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Pilloto SRL ("Pilloto", "we") uses cookies and similar technologies on the pilloto.com website. This policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy.

whatAreCookies.title: 1. What Are Cookies
whatAreCookies.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences and understand how you interact with the site. Similar technologies include local storage and session storage.

cookiesWeUse.title: 2. Cookies We Use
cookiesWeUse.body: Pilloto currently uses a minimal set of cookies. We do not run third-party advertising pixels, retargeting tools, or session recording software on the marketing website.

essential.title: 3. Essential Cookies
essential.intro: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off:
items: Cookie consent preference (pilloto_cookie_consent) — records your cookie consent choice. Persistent, first-party.
Language preference (i18nextLng) — stores your selected language. Persistent, first-party.

functional.title: 4. Functional Cookies
functional.intro: These cookies enable enhanced functionality. They are set only within the platform (not the marketing site):
items: Authentication token — identifies your logged-in session. Session-duration, first-party, httpOnly.
Tenant context — identifies which property you are accessing. Session-duration, first-party.

analytics.title: 5. Analytics Cookies
analytics.body: Pilloto does not currently use analytics cookies or third-party analytics services on the marketing website. If we introduce analytics in the future, we will update this policy and request your consent where required.

thirdParty.title: 6. Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.body: The pilloto.com marketing website does not embed third-party cookies, pixels, or tracking scripts. The platform application may interact with third-party services (e.g., OTA channel managers) as part of hotel operations — these are covered by the hotel's own data processing arrangements.

consent.title: 7. Consent
consent.body: When you first visit pilloto.com, we display a cookie consent banner. Essential cookies are set regardless of your choice because they are necessary for site functionality. If we introduce non-essential cookies in the future, they will require your explicit consent before being set.

manageCookies.title: 8. Managing Your Cookies
manageCookies.body: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time. Note that disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies through their privacy settings.

doNotTrack.title: 9. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control
doNotTrack.body: We respect browser Do Not Track (DNT) and Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals. Since we do not use non-essential tracking on our marketing site, these signals have no additional effect beyond our default behaviour.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time, particularly if we introduce new cookies or tracking technologies. The effective date at the top of this page will be updated accordingly.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.body: For questions about our use of cookies, contact us at info@pilloto.com.

aup.metaDescription: Rules for using the Pilloto hotel management platform, covering email conduct, data handling, and prohibited activities.
aup.intro: This Acceptable Use Policy ("AUP") defines the rules of conduct for all customers and users of the Pilloto property management platform. It is incorporated by reference into the Pilloto Terms of Service. Violations of this policy may result in suspension or termination of your account.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.body: Pilloto provides a multi-tenant property management platform. Each hotel customer operates in an isolated environment. Because our platform handles hotel guest data and sends transactional email on behalf of customers, we enforce strict rules to prevent abuse over email, data, and platform resources.

emailRules.title: 2. Email Rules
emailRules.intro: All outbound email sent through the Pilloto platform is transactional and system-triggered. You must not:
items: Send bulk unsolicited marketing email through the Pilloto platform
Upload purchased, rented, or scraped email lists
Use the platform to send messages to recipients who have not interacted with your property
Misuse reservation confirmation, folio, or notification emails for marketing content
Forge sender identities or disguise the origin of emails sent through the platform
Interfere with or circumvent bounce handling, complaint processing, or suppression lists

platformRules.title: 3. Platform Rules
items: Attempt to access another tenant's data or environment
Create fake reservations, fabricated guest records, or fraudulent financial transactions
Use automated scripts, scrapers, or bots to interact with the platform without our permission
Attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, or extract source code from the platform
Introduce malware, viruses, or other harmful code
Use the platform for any purpose unrelated to lodging operations

dataRules.title: 4. Guest Data Rules
dataRules.intro: Hotel customer data is processed under strict conditions. You must:
items: Only store and process guest data in connection with legitimate lodging operations
Comply with applicable data protection and privacy laws when handling guest data
Not export guest data from the platform for purposes unrelated to your hotel operations
Not share guest data with third parties except as required for your operations (e.g., channel managers)
Notify Pilloto promptly of any data breach affecting guest data stored in the platform

enforcement.title: 5. Enforcement
enforcement.body: Pilloto monitors platform usage and email deliverability metrics. If we detect a violation of this policy, we may take one or more of the following actions:
items: Issue a warning and request remediation
Temporarily suspend the offending feature (e.g., outbound email)
Suspend the tenant account pending investigation
Permanently terminate the tenant account
Report the violation to relevant authorities where required by law

reporting.title: 6. Reporting Abuse
reporting.body: If you believe a Pilloto customer is violating this policy, or if you receive unwanted communications originating from the Pilloto platform, please report it to

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.body: For questions about this Acceptable Use Policy, contact us at info@pilloto.com.

security.metaDescription: Learn about the security measures Pilloto uses to protect your hotel and guest data, including encryption, access controls, and incident response.
security.intro: Protecting our customers' data and their guests' data is a core responsibility. This page describes the security measures we implement across the Pilloto platform.

overview.title: 1. Security Overview
overview.body: Pilloto is a multi-tenant SaaS platform. We implement security at every layer — infrastructure, application, data, and operations — to keep each tenant's data isolated and protected.

infrastructure.title: 2. Infrastructure
infrastructure.body: Our infrastructure is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Key measures include:
items: Production workloads run in private subnets within a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
Network access is restricted through security groups and network ACLs
All external traffic is served over HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or higher
Database instances are not publicly accessible

accessControl.title: 3. Access Control
accessControl.body: We enforce strict access controls at both the platform and administrative levels:
items: Tenant isolation: each hotel's data is logically separated at the database level
Role-based access control (RBAC) within each tenant with configurable permissions
Platform administration requires separate super-admin credentials
Login attempt throttling to prevent brute-force attacks (5 attempts per 15 minutes)
Password hashing using bcrypt with appropriate cost factors

encryption.title: 4. Encryption
encryption.body: All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.2+. Data at rest on AWS services benefits from AWS-managed encryption. Authentication tokens use cryptographically signed JWTs with expiration controls.

monitoring.title: 5. Monitoring and Logging
monitoring.body: We maintain operational logs for security-relevant events including authentication attempts, permission changes, and administrative actions. Logs are retained in accordance with our data retention policies.

backups.title: 6. Backups and Recovery
backups.body: Production databases are backed up on a regular schedule. Backups are encrypted and stored in a separate location from production infrastructure. We test restoring procedures periodically to ensure data recoverability.

incidentResponse.title: 7. Incident Response
incidentResponse.body: Pilloto maintains an incident response process. In the event of a security incident that affects customer data, we will notify affected customers within 72 hours and provide relevant details about the nature and scope of the incident, as required by applicable law.

vendorSecurity.title: 8. Vendor Security
vendorSecurity.body: We evaluate the security posture of third-party services integrated into our platform. Our primary infrastructure and service providers (AWS, Amazon SES) maintain industry-recognised security certifications.

reporting.title: 9. Responsible Disclosure
reporting.body: If you discover a security vulnerability in the Pilloto platform, please report it responsibly to

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: For security questions or concerns, contact us at info@pilloto.com.

accessibility.metaDescription: Pilloto's commitment to digital accessibility, the standards we follow, and how to report accessibility issues.
accessibility.intro: Pilloto is committed to ensuring that our website and platform are accessible to all users, including people with disabilities.

commitment.title: 1. Our Commitment
commitment.body: We believe that everyone should be able to use our software regardless of ability. We are actively working to improve the accessibility of the Pilloto platform and pilloto.com website.

standards.title: 2. Standards
standards.body: We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA. We use these guidelines to inform our design and development decisions and to evaluate the accessibility of our products.

measures.title: 3. Measures We Take
items: Semantic HTML and ARIA attributes for screen reader compatibility
Keyboard navigability for all core interactions
Sufficient colour contrast ratios in our design system
Form labels and error messages associated with their fields
Alt text for meaningful images
Responsive design that works across devices and zoom levels

knownLimitations.title: 4. Known Limitations
knownLimitations.body: While we strive for full accessibility, some areas of the platform may have limitations that we are actively working to address. Complex interactive features such as the drag-and-drop booking calendar may have reduced accessibility on some assistive technologies. We welcome feedback to help us prioritise improvements.

feedback.title: 5. Feedback
feedback.body: If you experience any accessibility barrier while using Pilloto, or if you have suggestions for improvement, please contact us at

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.body: For accessibility questions or to request assistance, contact us at info@pilloto.com.
